testcase.system-out: Scenario: Filter drawing browser entries while retaining their parent branches ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open in the MCAD Software with border entries in its resources and sheet ✔ And the drawing browser branches are expanded ✔ When the user opens the drawing browser search field ✔ And the user enters "Border" ✔ Then matching border entries are displayed beneath their respective parent branches ✔ And matching text is highlighted ✔ And unrelated browser entries are hidden ✔ And the drawing sheet remains visible ✔ When the user clears the search text ✔ Then the unfiltered drawing browser tree is displayed ✔ When the user closes the empty search field ✔ Then the search field is hidden
